body.displayName: CUTOS — AI 對話式影片剪輯代理

capabilities.name: list_projects
capabilities.description: 列出所有專案。List all projects.

capabilities.name: get_project
capabilities.description: 取得專案狀態（含時間軸與預覽 manifest）。Get full project state.

capabilities.name: get_transcript
capabilities.description: 取得逐字稿（分頁）。Get the transcript, paged.

capabilities.name: search_transcript
capabilities.description: 在逐字稿中做字面搜尋。Literal substring search over the transcript.

params.name: query
params.description: 查詢字串（支援繁體中文）

capabilities.name: search_semantic
capabilities.description: 語意搜尋：找出談到某個主題的片段（不需字面相同）。Semantic retrieval over the transcript.

params.name: query
params.description: 查詢字串（支援繁體中文）

capabilities.name: list_speakers
capabilities.description: 列出說話者與各自發言時間。List speakers with speaking time.

capabilities.name: list_topics
capabilities.description: 列出影片談到的主題與時間範圍。List topics with time spans.

capabilities.name: find_highlights
capabilities.description: 找出適合做精華或短影音的片段。Find highlight candidates.

capabilities.name: inspect_scene
capabilities.description: 檢視某一段時間區間的內容摘要。Structured description of one time window.

capabilities.name: get_context_range
capabilities.description: 取得某段時間的逐字稿內容（有上限）。Bounded transcript window.

capabilities.name: build_semantic_context
capabilities.description: 建立要交給 AIOS 的受控語意脈絡（不送完整逐字稿）。Bounded semantic context for AIOS.

capabilities.name: get_job
capabilities.description: 查詢背景工作狀態。Get a background job's status.

capabilities.name: get_agent_run
capabilities.description: 查詢 CUTOS 剪輯代理執行狀態。Get a CUTOS agent run.

capabilities.name: get_preview
capabilities.description: 取得即時預覽 manifest。Get the instant-preview manifest.

capabilities.name: list_activity
capabilities.description: 取得跨系統活動事件（可從序號續讀）。Replay the cross-system activity log.

capabilities.name: analyze
capabilities.description: 分析影片（停頓、波形、逐字稿）。Enqueue media analysis. Returns a jobId.

capabilities.name: create_edit_plan
capabilities.description: 用自然語言指令建立剪輯計畫（待審核，不改動時間軸）。Create a staged edit plan.

capabilities.name: verify_edit_plan
capabilities.description: 驗證待審核計畫（是否過期、是否有不支援操作、影響多大）。Verify the staged plan.

capabilities.name: preview_edit_plan
capabilities.description: 產生待審核計畫的暫時預覽（不改動時間軸）。Ephemeral preview of the staged plan.

capabilities.name: preview_operation
capabilities.description: 產生單一操作的暫時預覽。Ephemeral preview of one pending operation.

capabilities.name: reject_operation
capabilities.description: 從待審核計畫移除一項操作。Remove one operation from the staged plan.

capabilities.name: apply_edit_plan
capabilities.description: 套用待審核計畫到時間軸（需要 expectedRevision）。Apply the staged plan.

capabilities.name: undo
capabilities.description: 復原上一個剪輯。Undo the last timeline mutation.

capabilities.name: redo
capabilities.description: 重做剪輯。Redo.

capabilities.name: export
capabilities.description: 輸出影片（需要人工核准）。Enqueue an FFmpeg export. Returns a jobId.

capabilities.name: create_sample_project
capabilities.description: 建立內建示範專案。Create a demo project from the built-in sample.

capabilities.name: cancel_job
capabilities.description: 取消背景工作。Cancel a background job.

capabilities.name: retry_job
capabilities.description: 重試失敗的背景工作。Requeue a failed job.

capabilities.name: cancel_agent_run
capabilities.description: 取消 CUTOS 剪輯代理執行。Cancel a CUTOS agent run.

capabilities.name: resume_agent_run
capabilities.description: 回報剪輯代理執行是否可續行（計畫是否仍有效）。Report whether a run can resume.

capabilities.name: plan
capabilities.description: [v1 相容名稱，請改用 create_edit_plan] 用自然語言指令建立剪輯計畫（待審核，不改動時間軸）。Create a staged edit plan.

capabilities.name: apply
capabilities.description: [v1 相容名稱，請改用 apply_edit_plan] 套用待審核計畫到時間軸（需要 expectedRevision）。Apply the staged plan.
